prompt: A clean remote-team SCHEDULING BOARD infographic, straight-on, styled like a project dashboard. Five horizontal rows, one per city, each labelled and showing that city's own working hours as a filled blue bar on a 24-hour row: Lisbon (UTC+0) works 09:00-16:00 local; Berlin (UTC+1) works 10:00-18:00 local; Istanbul (UTC+3) works 11:00-19:00 local; Dubai (UTC+4) works 10:00-17:00 local; Almaty (UTC+6) works 09:00-17:00 local. Below the five rows, a single green summary panel states the COMMON MEETING WINDOW when ALL FIVE cities are simultaneously within their working hours, expressed in Istanbul local time as 'HH:00 - HH:00' plus 'duration N hours'. Compute that window as the intersection of all five cities' working intervals on one shared timeline (each city has a DIFFERENT working span, so track every one), then convert the result into Istanbul local time. Note: this is an interval-overlap calculation across five different intervals, not a clock-face reading. Show the five bars and the one summary panel only; no other text.
